11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.136   578   578 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.424   589   589 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.738   594   594 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   in the oat file. Overrides --class-loader-context. Note that this ignores
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:40.809   595   595 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   in the oat file. Overrides --class-loader-context. Note that this ignores
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.050   602   602 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.091   603   603 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64: 
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64: --stored-class-loader-context={string value}
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   a string specifying the intended runtime loading context that is stored
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   in the oat file. Overrides --class-loader-context. Note that this ignores
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.155   605   605 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]

11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64: 
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64: --stored-class-loader-context={string value}
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   a string specifying the intended runtime loading context that is stored
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   in the oat file. Overrides --class-loader-context. Note that this ignores
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   the classpath_dir arg.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   classes are resolved during dex2aot as they would be resolved at runtime.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   This spec will be encoded in the oat file. If at runtime the dex file is
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   loaded in a different context, the oat file will be rejected.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   The chain is interpreted in the natural 'parent order', meaning that class
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   loader.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   E.g. if the context is 'PCL[lib1.dex];DLC[lib2.dex]' and 
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   --dex-file=src.dex then dex2oat will setup a PathClassLoader with classpath 
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   'lib1.dex:src.dex' and set its parent to a DelegateLastClassLoader with 
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   classpath 'lib2.dex'.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   Note that the compiler will be tolerant if the source dex files specified
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   with --dex-file are found in the classpath. The source dex files will be
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   removed from any class loader's classpath possibly resulting in empty
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   class loaders.
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   
11-15 20:08:41.422   611   611 E dex2oat64:   Example: --class-loader-context=PCL[lib1.dex:lib2.dex];DLC[lib3.dex]
